report_markdown:
**Recall watch** 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16
Held LOT 24-118 matches the Kestrel recall: do not eat it; return it for a full refund.

- **Kestrel Foods, Inc. granola: Class II recall** (FDA F-0388-2027, published 2026-11-12). Undeclared peanut. Affected: Lot 24-118, Lot 24-119, Lot 24-121; UPC 0 12345 67890 1; Best by 2027-03-01 through 2027-03-20. Do not eat; return to the place of purchase for a full refund. Questions: 1-800-555-0142, Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm CT. Your identifiers: LOT 24-118 matches; LOT 24-11 does not. [Official record](https://api.fda.gov/food/enforcement.json?search=report_date:%5B20261109+TO+20261116%5D&limit=100)

- **Brightwell Home Electronics BW-200: recall** (CPSC 27015, published 2026-11-13). Parent-unit batteries can overheat and cause burns. Affected: BW-200 parent units manufactured January 2025 through June 2025; cameras excluded. Check the MM/YYYY label inside the battery door. Stop using affected parent units and request a free replacement battery pack: 888-555-0190, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, or www.brightwell.example/recall. Your serial alone cannot establish coverage. [Notice](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2027/brightwell-home-electronics-recalls-bw-200-video-baby-monitors-due-to-burn-hazard)

- **NORTHLINE 2024 ROAMER: investigation—not a recall** (NHTSA PE26-014, opened 2026-11-10). Complaints allege liftgates fall closed as gas struts lose pressure; three complaints report minor injuries. No remedy is stated. Watch the investigation for findings or a subsequent recall. No held vehicle identifier was supplied. [Notice](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2024/NORTHLINE/ROAMER)

_Checked using supplied copies: FDA and CPSC (matching recalls); NHTSA recall API (zero recalls); NHTSA vehicle page (investigation). Live sites were declared unreachable; maker pages were not checked._
